foodProductMatrices.name: Thin Aqueous Bone Broth / Clear Stock (Viscosity: 1.1 cP, High Heat Transfer)
foodProductMatrices.description: Low viscosity allows aggressive natural thermal buoyancy currents, transferring jacket heat rapidly into the bulk liquid and maintaining modest jacket condensing pressures.

foodProductMatrices.name: Commercial Marinara Tomato Sauce (Viscosity: 2,800 cP, Moderate Convection)
foodProductMatrices.description: Moderate viscosity and high suspended solids retard convective heat dissipation; without active mechanical stirring, boundary layer heat transfer drops and elevates steam jacket pressure.

foodProductMatrices.name: High-Starch Polenta / Refried Beans (Viscosity: 22,000 cP, Severe Thermal Choke)
foodProductMatrices.description: Non-Newtonian pseudoplastic food matrix forms an immobile boundary layer against the hot inner kettle wall; heat cannot enter the food mass, forcing all burner energy into rapid jacket steam pressure accumulation.

foodProductMatrices.name: Heavy Cream Clam Chowder / Starch Roux (Viscosity: 9,500 cP, Thermal Boundary Choke)
foodProductMatrices.description: Dairy protein and flour gelatinization create an insulating barrier on the kettle hemisphere, driving jacket temperatures and pressures toward safety relief limits.

vacuumBreakerStates.name: Operational Spring-Loaded Vacuum Relief Valve (Cracks at -0.5 PSI)
vacuumBreakerStates.description: Properly functioning vacuum breaker admits atmospheric air instantaneously when condensing steam creates internal negative pressure, preventing kettle liner buckling.

vacuumBreakerStates.name: Partially Gummed Valve (Sticky Food Splatter / Scale, Cracks at -4.5 PSI)
vacuumBreakerStates.description: Residual cooking vapor condensate and hard water crust retard valve opening; kettle sustains moderate vacuum (-9 inHg) causing cyclic mechanical fatigue on welds.

vacuumBreakerStates.name: Frozen / Calcified Shut Vacuum Breaker (Zero Air Ingress, Deep Vacuum -28 inHg)
vacuumBreakerStates.description: Completely occluded breaker: rapid cool-down collapses steam into water (1,600:1 volume collapse), creating a near-perfect vacuum. Atmospheric pressure (14.7 PSI) crushes the hemispherical inner liner inward.

lowWaterProbeConditions.name: Clean Stainless Dual-Electrode Sensor (Immediate Burner Cutoff <30% Level)
lowWaterProbeConditions.description: Factory calibrated liquid level control board accurately senses distilled water resistivity; instantly de-energizes gas burner gas valve upon level drop.

lowWaterProbeConditions.name: Mineral Scale Bridged Electrode (Calcite Crust Conducts False Level Signal)
lowWaterProbeConditions.description: Conductive calcium and mineral scale coats the ceramic insulator, bridging the electrode tip to the kettle chassis; control board falsely reads 'water safe' while jacket boils completely dry.

lowWaterProbeConditions.name: Bypassed / Jumpered Low Water Board (Defeated Burner Safety Interlock)
lowWaterProbeConditions.description: Illegal technician jumper wire bypasses the low-water relay; burner fires continuously without water, heating bare stainless steel to over 600°C (red-hot) and causing thermal burn-through.
